id.description: The unique identifier for the flow

ownerId.description: The owner ID of the flow

assumePrincipalId.description: The ID of the principal to assume for the flow. If this is set to ~caller, then the flow assume the requester's identity for the duration of the flow run.  If this is set to ~owner, then the flow assumes the owner's identity for the duration of the flow run.

nodes.description: List of nodes used by the flow

links.description: List of links between nodes in the flow
